values.note: 'Reservations are accepted for all campground sites from May 1 to Oct. 26. All campground sites are also available as first come, first served.' Up to 6 months ahead on recreation.gov or 877-444-6777; recreation.gov closes booking 4 days before arrival, the Forest Service page says at least 3 days ahead. 14 nights per rolling 30 days. Fees are paid within 30 minutes of arrival.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/allegheny/recreation/hearts-content-recreation-area (Reservations) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/251943 (facility_rules maxStay 14 per rolling 30 days, minHolidayWeekendStay 3, reservationCutOff 4), read 2026-10-20

note: Allegheny NF campground beside the Hearts Content old-growth area and Hickory Creek Wilderness, run by concessionaire Allegheny Site Management. 26 single sites with RV spurs (listed 25-45 ft) plus a group site; vault toilets, hand-pump water, dump station, no hookups. Open May 1 to Oct 26, reservable on recreation.gov, and every site also first-come. Not on the water. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $12 fee, no hookups, 26 sites, dump; added 45-ft max rig, vault toilets/hand-pump water, the May 1-Oct 26 season (Forest Service statement) and full booking rules (recreation.gov, 6 months, 4-day cutoff, all sites also first-come, 3-night holiday minimum, 14 nights). Note corrected: the 'smaller sites -- verify length' caution is contradicted by the 25-45 ft catalog lengths.
